activity_summary: On the stair Mistress Ansell had an aired chamber, a dull parish of two banns and one cracked pane, and Heminges's note for Friday at nine. The hired bag was to leave the passage tonight. Alse had failed to move Gib off Field's Holinshed. You told the cat the book was Master Field's. You unpacked Anne's list before your own notes, and you did not read the list aloud. Verbeke had kept his room and his own name.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the note, set the unpacking order, and spoke to the cat.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Delivered the parish and the note, and set the bag's deadline at tonight.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Reported the cat, the pane, and a quiet lodger.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Heard from the back room. He was not renamed.

facets.activity: Heard Heminges's Friday note and unpacked Anne's list first

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: That hired bag goes out tonight.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Friday, at nine, the Theatre. His hand, not mine.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Off Holinshed, sirrah. He's Master Field's, and Master Field counts.
